alex (PM): Heads-up — kicking off prioritization for the next quarter focused on Console/Observability. Need alignment on retention, dashboard scope, tracing sampling, and error-analysis UX for a launch we can actually commit to.

samir (eng-runtime): quick q — do we consider per-tenant retention tiers from day 1 or start with a uniform policy + flags?

alex (PM): leaning toward uniform baseline + paid tiers later. Several customers (AcmeHealth, Shopwise) asked for longer retention today; we should capture must-haves vs nice-to-haves.

elaine (customer-success): AcmeHealth is a hard ask: 90 days of traces for compliance audits. They said they'll sign for dedicated if we can't deliver. Shopwise wants 30 days for dashboards + daily summaries.

maria (SRE): 90 days of traces at p95 traffic = huge storage + index costs. We need sampling strategy or KV-only retention for traces older than X. Also need retention SLOs defined.

jin (data): Agree. We could store full spans for 7 days, then a compressed trace index for 60-90 days. Means adding a compaction job and read-path that rehydrates on demand. Complexity: ~3 sprints.

samir (eng-runtime): Implementation concerns: our current trace pipeline writes to ES and object store. If we add compaction, we need a rehydration API and cache. Also backfills for customers on upgrade.

alex (PM): Proposal A (conservative): 30-day dashboards/events, 7-day full traces, 30-day compressed trace index (search-only). Launch criteria: dashboards with templated widgets, trace search & sampled flamegraphs, error analytics basic (grouping + top 5 regressions), retention controls in console (UI + API).

alex (PM): Proposal B (ambitious): 90-day compressed traces + 30-day full traces, advanced error-analysis (automatic regression detection + suggested fixes). Target later in quarter if infra commits.

elaine (customer-success): Customers will be happier with A if we ship clean UI and clear limits. They'd prefer B but understand rollouts.

maria (SRE): For A we need: quota-enforced ingestion, storage alarms, and a fallback plan (auto-sample to 0.1% when capacity spike). Add a dashboard for storage billing per org.

samir (eng-runtime): Rough engineering estimates: A = 4 devs x 6 weeks (runtime + console + pipeline tweaks). B = add 3 weeks + separate compaction infra + migration work.

jin (data): For cost modeling, here's a quick calc (very rough):
```
assume: 100GB/day org at p95
30 days => 3TB raw
compression/indices => 0.5x => 1.5TB cold
est cost => $0.02/GB-month => ~$30/mo/org
```
That lines up if we sample aggressively.

alex (PM): OK — decision framing: pick A as default launch plan, commit to an OKR for compaction roadmap to move to B by EOY if infra effort drops. Need customer commitments for beta.

samir (eng-runtime): One more thing: dashboards — do we ship custom widgets + shareable links or start with a curated set only? Curated cuts scope a lot.

elaine (customer-success): Curated + 3 templated widgets for each persona (ops, eng, product) would get buy-in. Customers often customize later.

maria (SRE): Also require RBAC + per-route retention override API for enterprise. That adds 1 sprint for auth plumbing. Important for Private deployments.

alex (PM): Noted. Prioritization vote: curated dashboards (must), retention UI (must), trace search sampled (must), 90-day compaction (stretch), regression auto-detect (stretch), per-tenant override API (must for Private customers).

samir (eng-runtime): I'll map tasks into eng-runtime backlog and flag blockers.

jin (data): I'll draft the data model for compressed trace index and a migration plan.

elaine (customer-success): I'll get commitment from AcmeHealth for a beta with 30 days if we promise visibility into roadmap.

maria (SRE): I'll add storage alarms and autosample runbook to runbook repo. Also propose a hard cap configuration to avoid runaway costs.

deploy-bot: Deployment window scheduled: infra-team/canary-slot-3 — 2029-05-21 02:00 UTC.

alex (PM): Next steps (action items):
- samir: initial scoping doc + risk matrix by EOW (1903070000).
- jin: data model + cost estimates by Wed.
- maria: runbook + alert thresholds by Thu.
- elaine: customer beta commitments and messaging by Fri.

alex (PM): If nobody objects, I'll lock Proposal A as the launch scope and create a roadmap epic. Callout: we will measure success via: time-to-insight (dashboard load), trace search latency p95 < 1s for sampled queries, retention-related billing variance < 20% month-over-month.

samir (eng-runtime): 👍 from eng-runtime.

maria (SRE): +1 from SRE, but we need a backup plan for worst-case cost.

jin (data): +1, will share models.

elaine (customer-success): +1, will confirm beta.

alex (PM): Great — locking. Will post the RFC and link here when ready. Thanks all. :rocket:
